app.name: ApartmentTogether
app.tagline: One shared list of every flat you're considering.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.joinHint: Sign in to join the hunt you were invited to.
auth.linkSent: Check your inbox. Open the link on this device to sign in.
auth.badCode: That code is wrong or has expired.
auth.notAllowed: This email isn't on the access list. Ask the hunt owner to add it.

account.title: Account
account.displayNameHelp: How your hunt partners see you.

hunts.title: Your hunts
hunts.empty: No hunts yet. Start one and invite the people you're searching with.
hunts.name: Name

settings.title: Hunt settings
settings.leaveConfirm: Leave this hunt? You'll need a new invite to come back.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}" and all its listings for everyone? This can't be undone.
settings.invitesHelp: Each link lets one person join and expires after 7 days.
settings.inviteShareText: Join my apartment hunt "{name}" on ApartmentTogether
settings.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change these.

join.title: Join hunt
join.invalid: This invite link is invalid, expired or already used. Ask for a new one.

list.empty: No listings yet. Paste a link from Otodom, OLX or any other site to start.

add.title: Add listing
add.urlHelp: Otodom, OLX, Gratka, Morizon… or any other site.
add.textPlaceholder: Paste the text of a Facebook post or any ad you can't link to.
add.checkFields: Check what we picked up from the text and fill in the rest.

listing.needsDetailsHelp: We couldn't read everything from this ad. Add the missing details.
listing.adRemovedHelp: The original ad is gone. This is the copy we saved.
listing.deleteConfirm: Delete this listing for everyone in the hunt?
listing.notFound: This listing doesn't exist or isn't in your hunt.
listing.alreadyAdded: This ad was already in the hunt, so here it is.

events.matched: It's a match: {who} made it unanimous
events.price_changed: Price on the original ad changed to {price}
events.ad_removed: The original ad was taken down
events.ad_restored: The original ad is back online

map.locationHelp: When you save, we place the listing from its address. Search or tap the map to set it yourself.
map.unlocated: No listings without a location | 1 listing isn't on the map: add its address. | {n} listings aren't on the map: add their addresses.

pins.title: Pins
pins.help: Places that matter to you, like work, a station or family. Every listing shows its distance to each pin.
pins.label: Name
pins.notFound: No match. Try another spelling, or tap the map.
pins.tapHint: Search above or tap the map to place it.
pins.picked: Placed at {lat}, {lng}. Tap the map to adjust.
pins.needLocation: Search an address or tap the map first.

compare.title: Compare
compare.needTwo: Pick at least two listings to compare.

distance.title: Distance to pins
distance.noPins: Add pins in Settings to see distances.
distance.noLocation: No location yet. Add an address or set it on the map when editing.

deck.reconsiderAsk: {name} asks you to take another look
deck.keyboardHint: Keys: ← no · ↑ maybe · → yes · Ctrl+Z undo

empty.title: You're all caught up
empty.allVoted: You've voted on every listing. New ones land here as soon as anyone adds them.
empty.noListings: No listings yet. Add the first one and start swiping.

reconsider.title: Reconsider this listing?
reconsider.help: If you said no, your vote is cleared and it's back in your deck. Anyone else who said no gets it back at the top of their deck.
reconsider.notePlaceholder: e.g. the price dropped, pets are OK after all
reconsider.sent: Sent. It's back at the top of their deck.
reconsider.cleared: Your no is cleared. It's back in your deck.

matches.empty: No matches yet. A listing lands here once everyone swipes yes.

disagreements.empty: No disagreements. Listings show up here when one of you says yes and another says no.

maybes.empty: No maybes. Swipe up on a card to park it here.

upkeep.mergeConfirm: Merge this listing into “{title}”? Its photos, comments and votes move over and this copy is deleted.

outcome.unchanged: Checked: the ad is up, no price change.
outcome.removed: Checked: the ad has been taken down.
outcome.restored: Checked: the ad is back online.
outcome.unknown: Couldn't reach the site right now. Try again later.

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.help: What the flat must have. A listing that breaks one gets a red badge but never disappears.
criteria.noPins: Add a pin below to limit the distance.

pipeline.hint: Drag a card up or down to another stage (hold the ⠿ handle on a phone), or tap it to change its status.
pipeline.noListings: No listings yet. Add some, then track them here from first contact to keys.
pipeline.title: Status

viewingNotes.promptHelp: Note your impressions while they're fresh. Everyone in the hunt sees them.
viewingNotes.textPlaceholder: Damp in the bathroom, lovely view from the kitchen…
viewingNotes.needOne: Rate at least one thing or write something.

share.title: Add a shared listing
share.nothing: Nothing came with the share. You can paste a link on the next screen.
share.noHunts: You have no hunts yet. Start one first, then share the listing again.

install.title: Install ApartmentTogether
install.body: Put it on your home screen, then share listings to it straight from Otodom, OLX or your browser.
install.ios: Tap Share, then 'Add to Home Screen'. The installed app can send you notifications.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: Nothing yet. You'll see matches, new listings and changes from your hunts here.
notifications.kindsHelp: Notify me about (here and as push):

text.match: It's a match: everyone said yes to {listing}
text.ad_removed: The ad for {listing} was taken down

push.title: Push notifications on this device
push.on: On. This device gets a notification for the kinds switched on below.
push.off: Off. Turn it on to hear about matches and changes even when the app is closed.
push.unsupported: This browser can't receive push notifications. The list under the bell still shows everything.
push.iosInstallFirst: On iPhone and iPad, add the app to your home screen first (Share → Add to Home Screen), then open it from there.
push.unconfigured: Push isn't set up for this app yet (no VAPID key). The list under the bell still works.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser settings, then come back.

transit.failed: Couldn't look up the public transport trip. We'll try again later.
transit.lookingUp: Looking up the public transport trip…
transit.arriveLegend: Public transport trips should arrive by
transit.arriveHelp: We look up the trip from each listing once, for the next such day, and keep it.

appUpdate.ready: A new version of the app is ready.
appUpdate.title: App version
appUpdate.unavailable: Couldn't check right now. Updates are checked in the installed or opened app when you're online.

browse.step1: On otodom.pl, search for flats to rent and set your filters.
browse.step2: Copy the address of the results page and paste it here.
browse.label: Name
browse.urlInvalid: That isn't an Otodom search results link. It should start with https://www.otodom.pl/pl/wyniki/
browse.deleteConfirm: Delete the search "{label}" and its results?
browse.neverRefreshed: Not loaded yet. Pull down or tap Refresh.
browse.justRefreshed: Just refreshed. Try again in a minute.
browse.foundNew: No new ads | 1 new ad | {n} new ads
browse.nothingNew: No new ads since the last check.
browse.empty: Nothing here. Change the search on Otodom or show hidden ads.
browse.sheetHelp: Adding it to the hunt counts as your yes. Your partner gets it in their deck.
browse.footer: Nothing is fetched in the background: pull down for the newest ads, scroll down for more.
browse.found: No ads found | Found 1 ad | Found {n} ads
browse.end: That's all Otodom has for this search.
browse.loadingAd: Loading the full ad from Otodom…
browse.adError: Couldn't load the full ad ({error}). Showing what the results list has.
